youtube.baslik: Should an audiology report name the disease? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Audiological interpretation describes hearing function; it does not make a medical diagnosis: moderate sensorineural hearing loss in the left ear is a suitable interpretation. If findings point to a possibility, cautious wording is used; medical diagnosis and treatment decisions belong to the physician. Recommendations are clear and, when needed, give a time frame.
